items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: Yeah, with the Mac Stitt Band. We were working there at some short-lived jazz club called the New Farm Club.

ctx.x: Well, you got around Ohio, that's right. Yeah, with the Mac Stitt Band. We were working there at some short-lived jazz club called the New Farm Club. And on one of our days off, my wife and the kiddies and I packed up and went out to the Air Force Museum. Which has nothing to do with jazz, I understand.

Well, that has something to do with you and you have something to do with jazz. It's all part of the same story. Anyway, I was thinking about all these brass bands and things and I asked you about carnival berets like the Jefferson City Buzzards. You said you weren't around magazines, streets, nights, or...
